content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] and when I connect it with [product_name] V8, the software detects the unit and lets me attempt to load the program. The information window shows no errors, but the device remains in Stop mode and won't start. Attempting even a simple one-line program leads to the same result. Is there a setting I may be missing? Everything I’ve read says it should switch modes automatically after loading, so maybe the program isn’t transferring. Any suggestions?
In the menu bar at the top, there are two icons for starting and stopping the [product_name].

Hello, I tried using those buttons to stop and start the device, but the status stays Red. When I load the program, the connection test passes and I confirm, but it still doesn't seem to load. I used the stop button before loading, then tried starting—yet it remains in Stop. When downloading, I am prompted for a password and use the default.
Is there truly no error message displayed?
No, the info box only shows pc-[product_name] and the program name.
Do you have the new [product_name] [article_no] FS04?
Hello, perhaps some screenshots might help clarify.

Do you have [product_name] V8.1? For the new [product_name] [article_no] FS04, you specifically need [product_name] V8.1. This version adds support for the new hardware option. Go to Tools > Select Hardware to choose it.
Hello, I assume this version is available for download from the official website. Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter challenges when trying to switch a [product_name] device from Stop to Run mode using [product_name] software, even after seemingly successful program transfers and with no error messages. Unclear feedback from the software and potential mismatches between hardware and software versions are identified as possible causes, resulting in a disruption to workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the device to seamlessly enter Run mode after transferring a program, and they seek clear instructions or guidance from the software if this process fails.
